signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: 3 low-star reviews (2.1% of all) say lifetime access was cut back or moved behind a subscription.

evidence.quote: I’ve noticed some new features now hidden behind a paywall, which is disappointing.
many of the features I was most excited about were locked behind this additional paywall
to use the truly interesting features, you need to pay more for add-ons

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: Usage is metered (credits or quotas) on the vendor's pages.

evidence.quote: If you reach (or are over) our row or attachment limits, you will still be able to use your stacks and we will never remove your data.
you will not be able to add more rows or attachments, until you upgrade your workspace to a new plan.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 6 reviews (4.1% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: You ask the same thing over weeks, zero human answers.
And support does not respond I've had an open ticket for over month
I have not received any replies from Stackby for several days in a row.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $109 tier lacks 1 of 16 features in the $218 tier and includes a zero allowance.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 9.1 years old. Sold on AppSumo once before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $109 vs a stated $160 regular price (32% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: We will also revise the terms set forth below on our sole discretion and will send you a notification for example via email.
We may add new services or entitled to adjust the prices for existing services, at any time, at our sole discretion, by giving customers at least 60 days of notice via email

claims.text: Stackby is a no-code platform combining spreadsheets, databases and automations

quote.text: Stackby is a no-code platform that combines spreadsheets, databases, and automations so anyone can build custom applications.

claims.text: Users can create databases with 30+ column types and multiple shareable views

quote.text: Create your own database with 30+ column types and multiple, shareable views.Collaborate with anyone

claims.text: Users can collect data with shareable forms and collaborate with comments, checklists and deadlines

quote.text: Collect data and edit records using forms that you can share with stakeholders or customersAdd comments, checklists, assignees, deadlines, or reminders to collaborate with your team from any device

claims.text: Users can build custom dashboards and design invoices and quotes

quote.text: Build custom dashboards with widgets like charts, summary boxes, goal trackers, and pivot tablesDesign custom invoices, quotes, and one-pagers in just a few clicks

claims.text: Stackby can pull live data from Meta Ads, YouTube and Google Analytics to refresh tables

quote.text: Even better, Stackby can pull live data from apps like Meta Ads, YouTube, and Google Analytics to automatically refresh your tables.

claims.text: Users can set up custom Zapier-style automations without coding

quote.text: Tired of doing the same tasks over and over? Stackby lets you set up custom Zapier-style automations to handle things for you—without any coding.

claims.text: Automations can create records, send emails and WhatsApp, and sync databases

quote.text: Automatically create and update records after new form submissions or incoming webhooksSend emails and WhatsApp messages without lifting a fingerSync multiple databases and keep all your data fresh

claims.text: If plan name changes, deal maps to new plan name with updates

quote.text: If Plan name changes, deal will be mapped to the new Plan name with all accompanying updates

claims.text: Codes must be redeemed within 60 days of purchase

quote.text: You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase

finePrint.summary: For a lifetime-deal buyer, the vendor can rewrite the terms on its own and continued use means acceptance.

quote.text: We will also revise the terms set forth below on our sole discretion and will send you a notification for example via email.

finePrint.summary: For a lifetime-deal buyer, regular prices can be raised at vendor discretion on 60 days email notice.

quote.text: We may add new services or entitled to adjust the prices for existing services, at any time, at our sole discretion, by giving customers at least 60 days of notice via email

finePrint.summary: For a lifetime-deal buyer, the vendor can terminate access at its sole discretion at any time without notice for non-compliance.

quote.text: We may terminate the agreement or use of Stackby, at our sole discretion at any time and without notice to you, if you or your Authorized users are not complying with these Terms

finePrint.summary: For a lifetime-deal buyer, unpaid fees can lead to subscription termination and loss of access without liability.

quote.text: We reserve the right to terminate your Subscription if you fail to pay any outstanding fees and bar access, without liability to the Service.

finePrint.summary: For a lifetime-deal buyer, paid plans are prepaid and non-refundable with no credits for partial use.

quote.text: Stackby’s paid Subscription plans are pre-paid and non-refundable. WE DO NOT PROVIDE CREDITS OR REFUNDS FOR ANY PARTIAL MONTHS OF USE OF SERVICE.

finePrint.summary: For a lifetime-deal buyer, over-limit workspaces keep existing data but cannot add rows or attachments until upgrading.

quote.text: If you reach (or are over) our row or attachment limits, you will still be able to use your stacks and we will never remove your data.

finePrint.summary: For a lifetime-deal buyer, adding more rows or attachments is blocked once limits are hit until you upgrade.

quote.text: you will not be able to add more rows or attachments, until you upgrade your workspace to a new plan.

finePrint.summary: For a lifetime-deal buyer, even entry plans are quota-bound by stacks, rows, storage and automation runs.

quote.text: 20 stacks 1500 rows per stack 2GB attachment per stack 100 Internal Automation Runs

finePrint.summary: For a lifetime-deal buyer, the comparable paid tiers start around $10 per user per month.

quote.text: For teams who need more records, databases and premium features, can choose between Economy, Business and Pro plans, starting at $10/user/month.

finePrint.summary: For a lifetime-deal buyer, annual plans are pitched as far cheaper than monthly billing.

quote.text: Our yearly plans are atleast 5x cheaper than our monthly plans and derive the most value for any team.

finePrint.summary: For a lifetime-deal buyer, help is offered via email, real-time chat and knowledge-base resources.

quote.text: Absolutely, our support team is here to help via email, real-time chat, and knowledge base resources.

trials.claim: Previous customers can buy more codes to increase feature limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers who purchased Stackby can buy more codes to increase their feature limits
trials.reasoning: Two buyers confirm they could upscale an existing license and pay a lifetime fee for extra features, outweighing the single report of yearly prices being shown.

exhibits.quote: You bought the lifetime here on AP, and you wanna buy the other one-time packages? You cannot becuase wheen you go in your account settings they show the YEARLY prices
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports lifetime owners cannot buy the one-time packages because account shows yearly prices instead.

exhibits.quote: having the option to upscale my license its better for me than other lifetime deals that asks me to pay full price whenever more users or features are needed.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms previous owners can upscale their license to get more users and features.

exhibits.quote: I ran into some account limitations (on features) but was able to pay a lifetime fee for the extra features
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms hitting limits but being able to pay to add extra features.

trials.claim: Previous customers will be grandfathered into new features and limits
trials.claimQuote: Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into any new features and feature limits
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports new features are hidden behind a paywall, directly conflicting with grandfathering previous customers into new features.

exhibits.quote: Meanwhile, I’ve noticed some new features now hidden behind a paywall, which is disappointing.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports new features are hidden behind a paywall instead of being grandfathered in.

trials.claim: Extra user add-on costs $120 annually per workspace
trials.claimQuote: Optional add-on: $120 per extra user paid annually per workspace
trials.reasoning: The only exhibit is about a Portals add-on for guests at $100/month, not the claimed $120 annual extra-user add-on, so it neither confirms nor contradicts that price.

exhibits.quote: Available Add-ons: Portals (Starting at $100 for 10 guests/month)
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists add-ons starting at $100 per month, undermining a flat $120 annual per-workspace extra-user price.

trials.claim: Powerups add-on costs $399 one-time per workspace
trials.claimQuote: Optional add-on: One-time-payment of $399 to enable Stackby Powerups in your workspace
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports Powerups requires a $149 per year add-on, conflicting with the claimed $399 one-time payment.

exhibits.quote: The "Powerups" that include functions for forms and tables that really look great are not usable unless you upgrade to a paid plan or purchase an add-on for $149 USD/year.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports Powerups requires a $149 per year add-on, contradicting a $399 one-time price.

trials.claim: Users can create databases with 30+ column types and multiple shareable views
trials.claimQuote: Create your own database with 30+ column types and multiple, shareable views.Collaborate with anyone
trials.reasoning: The vendor confirms 30+ column types and multiple data layouts/views; bug and performance complaints do not deny those features exist.

exhibits.quote: Have run into a ton of bugs and after spending hours setting up a stack which I was hoping to use for our business, it's become unusable.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports database setup became unusable due to bugs, undermining the create-and-share claim.

exhibits.quote: On top of this, the performance on my 650-row table is horrendous.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports horrendous performance on a small table, undermining usable database views.

exhibits.quote: 30+ unique columns types including link across tables, formulas, AI fields, checklists & attachments.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states databases offer 30+ column types as claimed.

exhibits.quote: Visualize your data in multiple layouts including grid, kanban, gallery, calendar, timeline, list, map, dashboards & more.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states data can be visualized in multiple layouts or views.

trials.claim: Users can collect data with shareable forms and collaborate with comments, checklists and deadlines
trials.claimQuote: Collect data and edit records using forms that you can share with stakeholders or customersAdd comments, checklists, assignees, deadlines, or reminders to collaborate with your team from any device
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports advanced form features are locked behind Power-Ups, materially limiting the claimed included form and collaboration functionality.

exhibits.quote: essential functionalities that I would expect to be standard in a tool like this, such as advanced form features or certain data recovery options, are designated as "Power-Ups."
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports advanced form features are locked behind Power-Ups paywall instead of included.

exhibits.quote: Build powerful forms with 30+ fields, conditional logic, multiple line-item support, updatable forms, themes, display elements and more.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states users can build powerful forms to collect data.

exhibits.quote: Setup due-dates and get in-app or slack reminders on each row.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms collaboration via due-dates and reminders on rows.

themes.summary: Happy users say Stackby handles data, automations and integrations well for their business.

hits.quote: It’s super easy to turn my spreadsheets into no-code apps, and the automation features save me so much time!

themes.summary: One buyer reports an over-limits warning despite staying within usage limits.

hits.quote: Now I'm getting an "over limits" warning on my account despite being well within the usage limits.

hits.quote: I have to spend approximately $450 USD/year

hits.quote: buying the 5 tier option and a $124 annual power up is literally $2.48/month per user.
